children: Australian shares were set to open lower on Thursday as investors weighed Federal Reserve minutes showing policymakers split on the rationale for higher interest rates, although stronger copper prices were likely to support miners.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.6%, an 18.7-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark ended down 0.1% on Wednesday.
